Following up on the runbook bits we walked through — a few technical clarifications and additions I pushed into the draft:

- KV cache warming: we recommend pre-warming the prefix cache for the top 10 routes 1 hour before canary start; command snippets are in the draft runbook.
- Canary health gate thresholds: set error-rate <= 0.5% and lat90 <= 600ms for green. If either breaches, we automatically pause and rollback.
- Rollback sequence (brief):
  1) Pause traffic to canary pool
  2) Switch routing policy to last-stable-model-tag
  3) Gradually reduce connections to canary hosts, drain KV lanes
  4) Monitor for 30 minutes; if stable, decommission canary hosts

Also flagged an optional staged-quantization check (low risk) that can be run on a duplicate test pool the day before cutover.

I’ll have cutover-runbook-v2.md ready with the command snippets by 2026-08-24 as discussed.

—Aditya
